Decision: Use custom PCB for pre-series EVT
Reason: Development board is not production architecture
Impact: Requires full SCH PCB DFM and target port

Decision: Use 12.8 V LiFePO4 40-60 Ah and solar 60-80 W
Reason: Customer-selected power class and autonomy goal
Impact: New power enclosure and external MPPT validation required

Decision: Support RU868 and EU868 on common PCB
Reason: Customer requested both radio variants
Impact: Profiles labels provisioning and RF evidence must remain separate

Decision: Allow ordinary pilot SIM without operator API
Reason: Station uses outbound connections through public APN or CGNAT
Impact: Requires local ICCID IMEI public APN and replacement process

Decision: Lock microphone geometry at triangle 120 mm and MIC4 plus 150 mm
Reason: Priority RКD geometry
Impact: All mechanics calibration and solver mapping inherit coordinates

Decision: Maintain independent 3D print vacuum casting and injection molding tracks
Reason: Processes need different geometry rules and evidence
Impact: No direct conversion of one CAD into released other process

Decision: Keep Android as separate release track
Reason: Application has independent lifecycle security and compatibility
Impact: Separate version SBOM APK and acceptance gates

Decision: Create dedicated branch evt-pre-20
Reason: Prevent mixing EVT-MB and pre-series evidence
Impact: Selective inheritance only

Decision: Assign all 20 pilot units to RU868
Reason: Customer selected RU868 for pilot
Impact: EU868 remains future compatibility only and is not provisioned in EVT-PRE-20

Decision: Keep both vacuum casting and injection molding enclosure tracks
Reason: Customer requested both casting variants
Impact: Replaced by final pilot allocation in DEC-014

Decision: Use two physical nano-SIM slots with one BG95
Reason: Customer requested two SIM cards
Impact: Requires external 2 to 1 mux and Dual SIM Single Standby safe-switch sequence

Decision: Support public and private APN profiles per SIM
Reason: Customer initially requested selectable APN modes
Impact: Replaced by public-only pilot policy in DEC-015

Decision: Test MTS MegaFon Beeline T2 Tele2 and GLONASS supplied SIM candidates
Reason: Customer defined pilot candidates
Impact: Exact carrier public APN and RAT remain per-SIM inputs; tariff is not an EVT input

Decision: Build the 20 pilot housings by vacuum casting with full-lot 3D fallback
Reason: Customer selected the primary and fallback processes
Impact: Prepare independent source packages for 3D print vacuum casting and injection molding; do not order TPA tooling without a separate decision

Decision: Use public APN only for EVT-PRE-20
Reason: Customer removed private APN and tariff dependency from pilot
Impact: Failover is limited to approved public profiles across two SIM slots; private APN is rejected

Decision: Use internal MSI HSI and PLL for STM32U585 high-speed clocking with no external HSE
Reason: Customer selected internal clock architecture
Impact: Remove HSE BOM and routing; retain SiT1552 32.768 kHz low-frequency reference and validate USB PDM PPS low-power and PLL transitions on target hardware

Decision: Use nRF52840 module for BLE commissioning diagnostics and OTA instead of ESP32-C3
Reason: Customer accepted nRF52840 provided required characteristics are not reduced
Impact: Primary module Raytac MDBT50Q-P1MV2 with integrated PCB antenna; Wi-Fi is removed as unused; verify enclosure RF range and operating temperature before final release

Decision: Use commissioned installation coordinates as the authoritative position of a fixed station
Reason: Customer requested spoof-resistant reference position without Wi-Fi
Impact: Android commissioning writes locked installation latitude longitude altitude and accuracy; station and Mukhoyed use configured coordinates for geometry/TDOA while GNSS position is monitored for drift/jam/spoof; coordinate changes require physical service mode and audit

Decision: Set EVT-PRE-20 operating ambient range to -40..+70 C
Reason: Customer accepted recommended environmental range
Impact: Components must be rated at least -40..+85 C where exposed to ambient; validate full-load operation at +70 C and cold start/operation at -40 C; LiFePO4 charging below 0 C prohibited unless approved low-temperature system is fitted

Decision: Expose both T5838 WAKE and THSEL AAD interfaces on every MIC leaf
Reason: Datasheet review showed THSEL is the one-wire AAD configuration/activation input while WAKE is only the event output
Impact: Rev.A MIC harness becomes 6-pin Molex Pico-Lock; pin5 WAKE; pin6 shared AAD_CFG/THSEL; STM32 PA15 pin77 drives AAD_CFG through U7 and PA8 pin67 receives aggregated WAKE; old 4/5-pin MIC connector variants are superseded

Decision: Keep evt-pre-20 and evt-mb release lines isolated
Reason: Customer prohibited mixing the two EVT configurations
Impact: No merge cherry-pick or release-file copy between EVT lines; reviewed common changes may be promoted separately to develop and main

Decision: Move LoRa DIO1 from PD8 to PC2 and keep microphone wake on PA8
Reason: PA8 and PD8 compete for the single selectable GPIO source of STM32U5 EXTI8
Impact: LoRa uses PC2 physical pin 17 and EXTI2 while MIC_WAKE remains PA8 physical pin 67 and EXTI8; PCB-MAIN capture and both reviews must be repeated

Decision: Drive E22-900M22S TXEN and RXEN from separate STM32 GPIOs
Reason: Current Ebyte E22-M v1.2 recommended circuit and truth table require explicit mutually exclusive RF-switch control
Impact: PB15 pin54 drives active-HIGH LORA_TXEN and PD8 pin55 drives active-HIGH LORA_RXEN; both have external 100 kOhm pull-downs and LOW startup state; U10 DIO2 is NC; any previous PCB-MAIN review remains invalid

Decision: Reject the legacy 868.1-868.7 MHz firmware channel list and keep RU868 TX disabled
Reason: The legacy list contradicts the customer-approved 864-865 and 868.7-869.2 MHz windows
Impact: Firmware accepts only the seven controlled candidate frequencies and requires a signed manufacturing profile plus regulatory and RF approval before TX

Decision: Support compact detection schemas 1 3 and 4 explicitly and reject all other versions
Reason: Silent interpretation of unknown schema versions can shift fields and corrupt events
Impact: Server decoder fails closed for unsupported schema values while retaining tested compatibility with controlled legacy messages

Decision: Separate PCB-MAIN placement candidate from manufacturing release
Reason: Native layout work must begin without allowing provisional footprints or absent routing to produce misleading factory outputs
Impact: Commit a six-layer placement-stage PCB with explicit provisional-footprint markers; block Gerber and Review B until footprint approval routing KiCad 9 DRC independent CAM factory DFM and RA-003 measurements pass
